utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Morag Pemberton. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that, Morag. I can look into it for you. Before we discuss the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s lovely, thank you. I can see the fees you mean. We’ll get that money refunded, don’t worry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. It’s been a lot to deal with, and I’m having chemotherapy at the moment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m really sorry you’re going through that, Morag. We can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, and I can also make sure you’re given extra time if you need it. Would either of those help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The extra time would help, thanks. I just want someone to take this seriously.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging this as a complaint now, and I’ll make sure it’s reviewed properly. Just so you know, our unarranged overdraft fees can never be refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: But you just said you’d refund them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re right, I did say that, and I’m sorry—I shouldn’t have promised an outcome before it’s been investigated. I’ll take ownership and make sure the complaint is looked at.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send this to our complaints team today. They’ll investigate the fees and send you a full written response within eight weeks. I’ll also call you by 30 October with an update, even if there’s no decision yet.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’ve logged your complaint about the overdraft fees, noted that extra time would help, and I’ll call by 30 October. The complaints team will send a full written response within eight weeks. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, it does. Thank you for listening.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Morag. I’m sorry this has added to what you’re already dealing with. Take care.
